name: Agent Skill Development
description: Create or revise a reusable agent skill through context, overlap review, workflow design, dry run, and handoff review.
approval_boundaries: Escalate substantial overlap with an existing skill.
Preserve license and attribution requirements for adapted content.

phases.name: Skill context
phases.instructions: Identify intended triggers, examples, repository rules, and existing related skills.

phases.name: Overlap review
phases.instructions: Review trigger clarity, responsibility overlap, context cost, and required resources.

phases.name: Operational design
phases.instructions: Implement concise operational guidance, references, metadata, and gates.

phases.name: Skill dry run
phases.instructions: Dry-run representative use and identify missing context or unsafe behavior.

phases.name: Publication handoff
phases.instructions: Verify metadata, validation, bundle decisions, risks, and exact next action.
